title: Lime Green Account: Wire Transfer Pricing
summary: This document details Lime Green Account wire transfer pricing: outgoing wire fees are $10.00 (domestic) and $25.00 (international) per transfer; up to 10 incoming domestic wires per monthly cycle are free, and additional incoming domestic wires may be charged. Outgoing fees are deducted when sent, while incoming charges apply when the wire posts.
